svg.title: Three things kill a script. Each has exactly one defence.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Three things kill a script. Each has exactly one defence.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A backup.sh box in the centre attacked from three sides: an unquoted variable that word-splits into two tokens, two scheduled copies starting at the same time, and a SIGTERM arriving mid-write. Beside each attack the fix is drawn in green — quoting the variable, an atomic mkdir lock, and write-to-temp-then-rename. Below, a crossed-out trap for SIGKILL and a three-run idempotence checklist where runs two and three must change nothing.
svg.text: Three things kill a script. Each has exactly one defence.
draw it from memory, then compare
